part.text:
All 19 tests in `tests/say.rs` pass (including the `#[ignore]`d ones via `--include-ignored`).

Implementation in `src/lib.rs`:

- **`under_hundred`** — handles 0–99: names below 20 directly, otherwise `TENS[tens]` plus an optional `-ONES[ones]` suffix (e.g. `22` → `twenty-two`).
- **`under_thousand`** — handles 0–999: `N hundred` optionally followed by the remainder via `under_hundred` (e.g. `123` → `one hundred twenty-three`).
- **`encode(n: u64)`** — splits `n` into chunks of 1000 (so `1_234_567_890` yields `[890, 567, 234, 1]`), renders each non-zero chunk with its scale word (`thousand`, `million`, `billion`, `trillion`, `quadrillion`, `quintillion`), and joins with spaces. Zero returns `"zero"`, and `u64` input means the extension up to `18_446_744_073_709_551_615` (`max_u64` test) works out of the box.
